text: Caller works as a mason on the Lake Amira water plant construction site. Says the subcontractor has not paid wages for three months to about forty workers. Says the site foreman tells women workers they will lose their jobs unless they are 'friendly' with him after the shift, and one woman was pushed into his office last week. Caller is afraid that if the company learns who called, she will be dismissed. Asks that her name not be given to the contractor.
